title: kate-syntax: keep fallback selection colors off the current line
summary: selection_color skips a fallback that equals the current line. The check covers the blue, the second blue, white, and black. The theme files stay as they are. Linux CI runs the test.

lane.reason: The work is pure Rust in the theme loader. Linux CI runs the test. It does not need a window or the owner's eyes.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: A fallback color is accepted only when it differs from BackgroundColor and from CurrentLine, for each of those colors the file sets. The order is Rgba(0x94, 0xCA, 0xEF, 0xFF), then Rgba(0x00, 0x5F, 0xA8, 0xFF), then white, then black. The existing selection tests stay green. Breeze light still returns the first blue. Leave the theme JSON files unchanged. Leave paint.rs unchanged. Leave keys.rs unchanged. PKT-0079 owns that file. Leave pair.rs unchanged. PKT-0083 owns that file. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: theme::tests::fallback_selection_color_differs_from_the_current_line
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. The background and TextSelection are #94CAEF. The current line is #005FA8. selection_color returns that second blue today, and that blue equals the current line. After the change the color is white. White differs from the current line and from the background.
